SIMULATED — THE REAL ENGINE, REPLAYED
Each project below is its complete MTDI studio. At build time the real MTDI engine ran on simulated inputs for 90 seconds; your browser replays what it produced. Every page says SIMULATED because it is. Run any of them live with python -m mtdi run projects/<id>.
